_comment: Which model the typhoon workflows run, in one place. Switching model used
to mean editing a release URL, a cache key, a weights directory name, a
calibration filename and a sparse-checkout list across three workflow
files -- 25 lines that all had to agree, and a job that failed obscurely
when one of them did not. Add an entry here instead and pass its key as
src_ref is pinned per model on purpose: typhoon-predict's default branch
has twice dropped a module an older model still imports, which breaks the
run quietly rather than loudly. Pin what the model was validated against.
outdir/index/driver decide WHERE a model's hindcasts land and WHICH live
driver builds its inputs. They are not cosmetic: the model input used to
switch only the weights, so a 1.2 run would have written its output over
the 1.1 hindcasts it exists to be compared against.
